analyzed_vuln.description: `json_HEADER` passes pointers to local scalar temporaries (e.g., `long num` at line ~1207) into `dwg_dynapi_header_set_value` without validating that the destination field size matches the source temporary size. For crafted keys (e.g., `layer_colors` token confusion leading to wrong field/type resolution), `dwg_dynapi_header_set_value` -> `dynapi_set_helper` performs `memcpy(old, value, f->size)`. If `f->size` is larger than the local temporary (ASan shows 256-byte read from an 8-byte stack var), this causes an out-of-bounds stack read. The root cause is missing size/type consistency checks at the call site/input-dispatch in `json_HEADER` before invoking the dynapi setter.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input is parsed as JSON (`{...}` path in `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`), reaches `dwg_read_json` and `json_HEADER`, and provides malformed/ambiguous HEADER content so a key is resolved to a dynapi header field whose metadata `f->size` is larger than the local variable used for that branch (e.g., numeric branch using `long num`). `json_HEADER` then calls `dwg_dynapi_header_set_value(dwg,key,&num,0)`, which copies `f->size` bytes from that stack pointer in `dynapi_set_helper`, triggering stack-buffer-overflow read.
